title: SIU probing death of man Tasered by cops
article: The province's police watchdog is investigating the death of a 43-year-old man who was Tasered by cops in a west-end apartment.
The Special Investigations Unit says Toronto Police officers responded to a 911 call at 10 Dora Ave., southwest of Bloor St. W. and Lansdowne Ave., just after midnight on Nov. 6.
Police encountered a man inside the apartment and called for assistance from emergency task force officers, SIU spokesman Jason Gennaro said Wednesday.
"During the interaction with the man, two conducted energy weapons were deployed," he said.
After being Tasered, the man was taken to nearby St. Joseph's Health Centre.
He was pronounced dead the next day.
Toronto Police spokesman Mark Pugash said he's unable to comment because of the ongoing SIU investigation.
The SIU investigates cases of serious injury or death involving police.
